3. Generate one test image, show it to me, and only then the rest. Reject and regenerate any image with bad hands, broken text or a face that does not match its character's bible entry; keep a list of which prompts needed a redo.
4. Depth for motion: for each art screen, cut the character out (rembg) and fill the hole behind it (outpaint or inpaint the background with the same generator, or a cheap smear-and-blur if the move is small). Now each screen is 2-3 layers: background, character, optional foreground prop. Upscale every layer 2x so the push-in never goes soft.
5. Motion (all in code, no AI video): render each art screen as a 2.5D parallax move: background moves 40%, character 100%, foreground 140% of the camera move, all with an ease-in-out curve over the hold. Add life on top where it fits: drifting dust or haze, a light flicker on neon signs, palm-shadow sway, heat shimmer, a slow cloud slide. Never move a body part of a character.
6. The opener: build it in one HTML page with canvas and WebGL. The marble is a domain-warped noise shader with a slow time offset and a palette ramp; scanlines, chroma noise and barrel warp are a post-process pass; the typing is a timed string reveal; the datamosh is the previous frame block-shifted by a noise field; the postcard flash is one generated image; the neon stroke is an SVG path animated with stroke-dashoffset plus a blurred copy for the glow; the gradient fill rises through a clip mask. Export frames with Playwright at 60 fps, and lay a tape-hiss bed, a key click per character, a glitch crunch and a deep hit under it.
7. Edit to the music: find the music's beat grid and phrases, put each art screen change on a phrase start, the studio logo's glow on a hit, and the last fade on the final note. Assemble everything with FFmpeg, add a 0.6% film grain and a very light vignette, and export 1080p60 at a high bitrate. For the loop version, repeat the cycle in a new order each time so no screen comes round in the same sequence twice.
8. Check: pull one frame from the middle of every art hold at full size and look for AI tells; play every transition and the logo build at full speed; make sure the loop seam is invisible. - Generators write gibberish on signs. Ask for "no readable text", then add any signage yourself as a layer.
- Cutting a character out leaves a hole: fill the background before you move the layers, or the parallax reveals a ghost.
- A push-in on a 1536 px image goes soft fast. Upscale before the move and keep the zoom under 6%.
- A loading screen is not a slideshow: keep the logo and loader on screen, make every transition a dip through black, and never cut hard.
- Holds that don't land on the music's phrases feel random. Cut to the phrases, not to the clock.
- Using the publisher's own art, logo or legal text as if it were real gets the video claimed or taken down. Design your own studio logo and title treatment in the franchise's spirit, label it "fan concept", and credit the music.
- Other channels' "concept" music tracks are someone else's work: use only music you own or have a licence for.
- Image generation costs money: one approved test image before the batch, and a running count of what has been spent.

1. CENTRAL LANDMARK

Feature one iconic landmark as the dominant subject.
Preserve its authentic architectural silhouette and recognisable details.

Surround the landmark with a simple, elegant abstract landscape.

Large circular sun or moon behind the architecture.
Layered geometric mountains and hills.
Simple curved foreground shapes.
Minimal architectural platforms or steps.
Clean overlapping paper layers.
No unnecessary decorative elements.

This is the defining feature.

Intricately rolled and curled paper strips.
Fine spiral coils and delicate loops.
Precisely arranged parallel paper lines.
Raised paper edges and visible thickness.
Beautifully sculpted architectural curves.
Realistic miniature paper craftsmanship.
Subtle natural shadows between individual paper pieces.

The quilling should be most detailed on the landmark, while the surrounding landscape remains clean and minimal.

Choose a completely different colour palette for every destination.

Use 4–6 coordinated colours inspired by the landmark’s architecture, culture and surroundings.

Landmark paper coils.
Background sun.
Geometric mountains.
Foreground landscape.
Supporting paper details.

Avoid repeating colour combinations across destinations.

Soft, pale neutral background.

Realistic soft shadows.
Professional gallery-style presentation.
Front-facing, perfectly balanced composition.

Premium handmade paper-quilling artwork, minimalist architectural illustration, geometric landscape design, intricate paper sculpture, tactile cardstock texture and sophisticated gallery presentation.

KOREAN HANJI PAPER ART | WHIMSICAL 3D MINIATURE DIORAMA

Create a beautiful, highly detailed, handcrafted 3D paper-art illustration featuring [TYPE YOUR SUBJECT / OBJECT / CITY / SCENE], reimagined through the traditional Korean Hanji paper-art aesthetic.

ART DIRECTION & VISUAL STYLE

Transform the entire scene into an imaginative miniature world made from layered Korean Hanji paper. Use authentic handmade paper textures, visible delicate fibres, subtle wrinkles, torn edges, embossed details and carefully cut paper elements.

Combine traditional Korean visual heritage with contemporary lifestyle, architecture and modern objects. The result should feel like a sophisticated fusion of Korean folk art, paper sculpture and playful contemporary design.

COMPOSITION & STORYTELLING

Build a rich, three-dimensional miniature environment around the main subject. Make the primary subject instantly recognizable and visually dominant.

Surround it with thoughtfully selected supporting elements that complement the subject. Incorporate traditional Korean architectural details, colourful urban surroundings, decorative patterns, miniature props and unexpected creative combinations wherever appropriate.

Create a visually engaging composition with convincing depth, overlapping paper layers, realistic miniature proportions and carefully arranged foreground, middle ground and background.

MATERIALS & TEXTURES

- Traditional Korean Hanji paper with visible natural fibres.
- Layered and sculpted paper architecture.
- Intricate cut-paper ornaments and embossed details.
- Soft handmade imperfections and tactile surfaces.
- Rich paper-cut textures with dimensional shadows.
- Handmade miniature objects with convincing physical construction.

COLOUR & LIGHTING

Use a vibrant yet harmonious palette of warm terracotta, turquoise, cobalt blue, mustard yellow, coral, cream and earthy browns.

Introduce beautiful atmospheric lighting, soft directional sunlight, gentle shadows and subtle highlights that emphasize the layered paper construction.

FINAL AESTHETIC

The finished artwork should resemble an exceptionally crafted miniature paper sculpture photographed in a professional studio. Blend whimsical storytelling, Korean cultural identity, contemporary creativity and premium editorial illustration.

Ultra-detailed, tactile, colourful, imaginative, visually balanced, handcrafted 3D paper diorama. Every element must appear constructed from real Hanji paper rather than digitally painted or rendered plastic.

FORMAT: Square 1:1 composition. No text, captions, typography, watermarks or logos.

艺术指导与视觉风格

将整个场景转化为一个由层叠韩国韩纸构成的奇幻微缩世界。运用 authentic 手工纸张质感、可见的细腻纤维、细微褶皱、撕裂边缘、压纹细节以及精心剪裁的纸艺元素。

将传统韩国视觉传承与当代生活方式、建筑及现代物件相结合。成品应呈现为韩国民间艺术、纸雕与趣味当代设计的精致融合。

构图与叙事

围绕主体构建一个丰富的三维微缩环境。使主体一目了然且在视觉上占据主导地位。

以经过深思熟虑挑选的辅助元素环绕主体，使其与主体相得益彰。在合适之处融入传统韩国建筑细节、色彩缤纷的城市环境、装饰纹样、微缩道具以及出人意料的创意组合。

创作具有说服力深度的视觉吸引力构图，包含交叠的纸层、真实的微缩比例，以及精心安排的前景、中景与背景。

材质与纹理

- 传统韩国韩纸，带有可见的天然纤维。
- 层叠并塑形的纸质建筑。
- 精细的剪纸装饰与压纹细节。
- 柔和的手工瑕疵与触感表面。
- 丰富的剪纸纹理与立体阴影。
- 手工微缩物件，呈现令人信服的实体构造。

色彩与光线

使用 vibrant 而和谐的配色：暖陶土色、绿松石色、钴蓝、芥末黄、珊瑚色、奶油色与大地棕色系。

引入美妙的氛围光、柔和的方向性阳光、轻柔阴影与微妙高光，以强调层叠的纸质构造。

最终美学

成品应像一件工艺非凡的微缩纸雕作品，在专业影棚中拍摄。将奇趣叙事、韩国文化身份、当代创造力与高端编辑插画融为一体。

超精细、有触感、色彩丰富、充满想象力、视觉平衡的手工 3D 纸艺立体场景。每一个元素都必须看起来由真正的韩纸构成，而非数码绘制或渲染的塑料质感。

格式：方形 1:1 构图。无文字、字幕、排版、水印或标识。

Create an exceptionally beautiful, ultra-minimalist Bauhaus-inspired architectural travel poster featuring [LANDMARK NAME], [CITY], [COUNTRY].

1. ICONIC ARCHITECTURAL SILHOUETTE

Feature the destination’s most recognisable landmark as the central artistic subject.

Preserve its authentic architectural identity and instantly recognisable silhouette.
Simplify the structure into clean geometric lines, rectangles, circles, triangles and elegant architectural proportions.
Use minimal details to communicate the landmark’s character.
Make the architecture appear as though it has been constructed from carefully arranged geometric paper cutouts.
Avoid photorealism, excessive details and complicated textures.

2. GEOMETRIC ARTISTIC COMPOSITION

Build the entire poster around a striking arrangement of oversized geometric shapes.

Large semicircles and circles representing the sun or moon.
Bold rectangular architectural foundations.
Angular trapezoids and triangular landscape forms.
Layered geometric platforms supporting the landmark.
Carefully overlapping shapes creating depth.
Simple curved forms and architectural abstractions.

Use only shapes that complement the landmark’s natural structure.

3. UNIQUE DESTINATION-INSPIRED COLOURS

This is the most important part of the collection.

Create a completely different 4–6 colour palette for every destination.

Choose colours inspired by the destination’s architecture, history, cultural identity and natural surroundings.

Use bold primary or complementary colours, balanced with warm ivory or soft neutral backgrounds.

Never repeat the same colour combinations between destinations.

4. MINIMALIST GRAPHIC STYLE

Flat vector illustration.
Solid colour blocks.
Crisp architectural outlines.
Strong geometric contrast.
Subtle vintage paper texture.
Perfectly controlled negative space.
Clean, sophisticated modernist aesthetic.
No gradients unless absolutely necessary.
No unnecessary decorative elements.

5. TYPOGRAPHY AND LAYOUT

At the top, display the destination name in oversized, bold, uppercase geometric sans-serif typography.

[DESTINATION NAME]

At the bottom, add a small artistic caption:

[COUNTRY]

Include a discreet design movement label such as BAUHAUS.

Keep the typography exceptionally clean, balanced and beautifully spaced.

6. SIGNATURE ART DIRECTION

Inspired by original Bauhaus graphic design, Swiss modernism, mid-century travel advertising and minimalist architectural illustration.

The poster must look like a timeless collectible from an international design exhibition.

The composition should be instantly recognisable even from a distance.

Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio. Warm ivory background. No borders, no photographs, no people, no flowers, no leaves, no watermarks and no unnecessary text.

创作一张非凡精美、极度极简、包豪斯风格的建筑旅行海报，呈现 [LANDMARK NAME]、[CITY]、[COUNTRY]。

1. 标志性的建筑剪影

将该目的地最具辨识度的地标作为核心艺术主体。

保留其真实的建筑身份与一眼可辨的剪影。
将结构简化为干净的几何线条、矩形、圆形、三角形与优雅的建筑比例。
用最少的细节传达地标的character。
让建筑看起来仿佛由精心排列的几何纸质剪贴物搭建而成。
避免照片写实、过多细节与繁复纹理。

2. 几何艺术构图

以一组引人注目的超大几何形状构建整张海报。

代表太阳或月亮的大型半圆与圆形。
大胆的矩形建筑基座。
棱角分明的梯形与三角形景观形态。
层层叠置的几何平台承托地标。
精心交叠的形状营造纵深。
简洁的曲线形态与建筑抽象。

只使用与地标自然结构相衬的形状。

3. 独特的目的地灵感配色

这是整个系列中最重要的部分。

为每个目的地创作一套完全不同的 4–6 色调色板。

从目的地的建筑、历史、文化身份与自然环境中汲取配色灵感。

使用大胆的原色或互补色，并以暖象牙白或柔和的中性色背景取得平衡。

绝不在不同目的地之间重复相同的配色组合。

4. 极简图形风格

扁平矢量插画。
纯色色块。
清晰锐利的建筑轮廓。
强烈的几何对比。
微妙的复古纸张质感。
完美克制的留白。
干净、精致的现代主义美学。
除绝对必要外不使用渐变。
不加多余的装饰元素。

5. 字体排版与布局

在顶部，以超大号、粗体、全大写的几何无衬线字体展示目的地名称。

[DESTINATION NAME]

在底部，加入一行小巧的艺术性说明文字：

[COUNTRY]

加入一处低调的设计流派标签，例如 BAUHAUS。

保持字体排版异常干净、平衡且间距美观。

6. 标志性艺术指导

灵感源自包豪斯原创平面设计、瑞士现代主义、中世纪旅行广告与极简建筑插画。

海报必须看起来像国际设计展中的永恒收藏品。

即使远距离观看，构图也应一目了然。

竖版 2:3 画幅比例。暖象牙白背景。无边框、无照片、无人像、无花卉、无树叶、无水印、无多余文字。

大胆的形状与经过精心控制的比例。

从目的地的文化特征、建筑风格与自然环境中汲取灵感，打造完全独具特色的色彩识别。

流畅的有机曲线。
平面化的图形插画。
细腻的纸张颗粒纹理。
极少量且有选择地使用渐变。
优美的色块分割。

Illustrate its recognisable architectural structure using simplified geometric shapes, clean silhouettes, elegant curves and carefully constructed flat-colour forms.
Preserve the landmark’s distinctive architectural identity, proportions and signature details.
Transform complex architectural details into beautifully simplified artistic elements.
Integrate the architecture naturally into the surrounding abstract landscape.

2. ORGANIC GEOMETRIC LANDSCAPE

Create an imaginative environment using a combination of abstract geometric and organic forms.

Oversized circles, semicircles and curved shapes representing the sun and moon.
Flowing hills, layered mountains and abstract landscape formations.
Architectural arches, rectangular frames and sculptural platforms.
Overlapping organic shapes creating beautiful depth and dimension.
Simplified trees, water bodies, pathways and natural elements.
Large geometric foreground elements framing the landmark.

Every shape should feel intentional, balanced and artistically connected.

3. DISTINCTIVE COMPOSITION

Create a visually striking composition inspired by contemporary Swiss graphic design, Bauhaus principles and modern editorial illustration.

Strong central architectural arrangement.
Beautiful interaction between positive and negative space.
Layered foreground, middle ground and background.
Oversized abstract forms framing the architecture.
Elegant asymmetrical balance.
Bold shapes with carefully controlled proportions.
Avoid unnecessary details and visual clutter.

4. UNIQUE DESTINATION COLOUR PALETTE

Develop a completely distinctive colour identity inspired by the destination’s cultural character, architecture and natural environment.

Use approximately 5–7 carefully coordinated colours.

Combine bold contrasting tones with sophisticated muted shades, warm neutrals and occasional unexpected accents.

Every destination must receive its own original palette. Never repeat colour combinations across the collection.

5. COLOUR AND SHAPE INTERACTION

Use large areas of solid colour, subtle overlapping forms and beautifully controlled tonal transitions.

Crisp, clean edges.
Smooth organic curves.
Flat graphic illustration.
Subtle paper-grain texture.
Minimal gradients used selectively.
Beautiful colour blocking.
No excessive photorealism or 3D effects.

6. POSTER TYPOGRAPHY

Include sophisticated editorial typography.

Main title: [DESTINATION NAME]

Secondary text: [COUNTRY]

Add a small poetic tagline inspired by the destination.

Use elegant oversized contemporary serif or refined modern sans-serif typography.

Typography should feel like an integral part of the composition rather than an afterthought.

7. FINAL ART DIRECTION

A beautiful fusion of minimalist architecture, organic geometry, contemporary graphic design, modernist illustration and premium international travel poster aesthetics.

The finished artwork should feel timeless, intelligent, artistic, visually memorable and suitable for a prestigious design exhibition.

Museum-quality graphic composition, exceptional colour harmony, clean silhouettes, refined details and sophisticated visual storytelling.

Portrait 2:3 format. No borders, no watermark, no unnecessary text. Preserve the authentic recognisable identity of the landmark.

创作一幅非凡精美、精致简约的几何建筑风格旅行海报，呈现 [LANDMARK NAME]、[CITY]、[COUNTRY]。

1. 中心建筑主体

以标志性建筑作为画面中占主导地位的中心焦点。

使用简化的几何形状、干净的剪影、优雅的曲线以及精心构建的平涂色块来表现其可辨识的建筑结构。
保留该地标独特的建筑身份、比例与标志性细节。
将复杂的建筑细节转化为优美简化的艺术元素。
使建筑自然地融入周围的抽象景观之中。

2. 有机几何景观

结合抽象几何形态与有机形态，创造富有想象力的环境。

用超大圆形、半圆形和曲线形状表现太阳与月亮。
起伏的山丘、层叠的山峦以及抽象的地貌形态。
建筑拱门、矩形框架与雕塑感平台。
相互重叠的有机形状营造优美的景深与立体感。
简化的树木、水体、路径与自然元素。
以大型几何前景元素为地标构架画面。

每一个形状都应显得有意为之、平衡且在艺术上彼此呼应。

3. 独特的构图

创作一幅极具视觉冲击力的构图，灵感源自当代瑞士平面设计、包豪斯原则与现代编辑插画。

强有力的中心建筑布局。
正形与负形之间的优美互动。
前景、中景与背景的层次划分。
以超大抽象形态为建筑构架。
优雅的不对称平衡。
大胆的形状与经过精心控制的比例。
避免不必要的细节与视觉杂乱。

4. 独特的地域配色

从目的地的文化特征、建筑风格与自然环境中汲取灵感，打造完全独具特色的色彩识别。

使用约 5–7 种精心协调的颜色。

将大胆的对比色调与精致的低饱和色、暖中性色以及偶尔出现的新颖点缀色相结合。

每个目的地都必须拥有其独有的原创配色。绝不在整个系列中重复使用相同的色彩组合。

5. 色彩与形状的互动

运用大面积纯色、微妙重叠的形态以及优美受控的色调过渡。

清晰、干净的边缘。
流畅的有机曲线。
平面化的图形插画。
细腻的纸张颗粒纹理。
极少量且有选择地使用渐变。
优美的色块分割。
不过度追求照片写实或 3D 效果。

6. 海报字体排印

融入精致的编辑式字体排印。

主标题：[DESTINATION NAME]

副文本：[COUNTRY]

加入一句受该目的地启发的小幅诗意标语。

使用优雅的超大号当代衬线字体或考究的现代无衬线字体。

字体排印应 feels like 画面构图的内在组成部分，而非事后的附加之物。

7. 最终艺术指导

极简建筑、有机几何、当代平面设计、现代主义插画与高端国际旅行海报美学之间的美妙融合。

成品的画面应显得永恒、智能、艺术性强、令人过目不忘，并适合 prestigious 的设计展览。

博物馆级的图形构图、出色的色彩和谐度、干净的剪影、考究的细节以及精致的视觉叙事。

竖版 2:3 比例。无边框，无水印，无多余文字。保留地标真实且可辨识的身份特征。

【角色抽卡】
每张独立选择一位具有鲜明辨识度的经典动漫或游戏成年角色，男女不限，作品来源开放。

准确保留原作标志性的发型、头部轮廓、经典服装、关键配饰及代表性武器，让人物即使完全由文字构成，依然能够辨认其角色身份。

【角色专属文字】
整座雕塑完全由与当前角色直接相关的文字构成。

根据角色原作设定，选择真实准确的姓名、别名、称号、所属组织、武器名称、技能名称、能力属性及具有代表性的世界观关键词。

允许混合中文、日文、英文及角色原作涉及的其他语言。

每张选择少量具有代表性的关键词，通过不同尺寸、方向与重复组合构成完整雕塑。

文字内容必须与角色身份对应，具有明确含义。重要文字保持完整可辨，优先使用准确的短词与短句。

【实体文字雕塑】
所有文字都是具有真实厚度的独立金属构件，通过局部交叠与精细焊接形成连续的三维开放式网格。

文字沿角色的头部、五官、头发、身体、服装与配饰的立体曲面自然排列。

通过字符的大小、方向、疏密和空间起伏塑造人物形态。

面部、头发与服装均由文字本身形成，文字间保留清晰的镂空间隙，可以透过雕塑看到背后的真实空间。

根据角色经典配色，在银色、深色金属及少量彩色金属之间自然选择，保留真实金属反光、连接节点和投影。

【构图与摄影】
每张根据角色气质自由设计雕塑姿态、观察角度与构图。

真实当代艺术美术馆展览摄影，雕塑具有大型公共艺术装置的尺度感。

柔和展览灯光，真实空间透视，文字镂空产生自然交错的投影。

单张独立完整画面，主体突出，留白疏朗，具有当代艺术雕塑的高级感。

画面中的雕塑构造文字全部与当前角色相关。
